name: Keep Awake
author: zen
description: Keeps the machine awake with the lid closed while you listen to a video

barWidget.description: Keep the machine awake with the lid closed for a chosen duration

schema.label: Default duration
schema.description: Duration toggled by left-clicking the icon.

schema.label: Adjustment step (minutes)
schema.description: How many minutes a right click adds, or the mouse wheel adds or removes.

schema.label: Show remaining time
schema.description: Shows the countdown next to the icon while Keep Awake is active.

schema.label: Suspend when finished
schema.description: Suspend the machine when the timer ends if the lid is still closed.
